Not voting, Not elected, neutral and unknown are not contrary votes. Distinguish sponsorship, a pledge to sponsor, and a recorded vote. Do not merge differently dated bills or turn a period into an exact vote date. Use the structured evidence, not an earlier narrative, to resolve meaning.
